58270-blue-jackets-or-the-adventures-of-.creator: Unknown
58270-blue-jackets-or-the-adventures-of-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The deserter was an able seaman named Tom Clare, a sober, excellent sailor, and the devoted husband of a worthy girl to whom he had been but a few weeks united. Tom had not long before arrived home from the China Station in H.

arxiv-2105-05986.title: Probing dynamical criticality near quantum phase transitions
arxiv-2105-05986.creator: Ceren B. Dağ, Yidan Wang, Philipp Uhrich, Xuesen Na, Jad C. Halimeh
arxiv-2105-05986.description: Abstract We reveal a prethermal temporal regime upon suddenly quenching to the vicinity of a quantum phase transition in the time evolution of 1D spin chains. The prethermal regime is analytically found to be self-similar, and its duration is governed by the ground-state energy gap.

arxiv-2201-00397.title: Dispersion of Free-Falling Saliva Droplets by Two-Dimensional Vortical Flows
arxiv-2201-00397.creator: Orr Avni, Yuval Dagan
arxiv-2201-00397.description: Abstract The dispersion of respiratory saliva droplets by indoor wake structures may enhance the transmission of various infectious diseases, as the wake spreads virus-laden droplets across the room. Thus, this study analyses the interaction between vortical wake structures and exhaled multi-component saliva droplets.

arxiv-2205-05343.title: Learning Multitask Gaussian Bayesian Networks
arxiv-2205-05343.creator: Shuai Liuabel=e1, mark]hljliushuai@stu.xjtu.edu.cn, Yixuan Qiu, Baojuan Li, Huaning Wang, Xiangyu Changabel=e5, mark]xiangyuchang@xjtu.edu.cn
arxiv-2205-05343.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shuai Liuabel=e1, mark]hljliushuai@stu.xjtu.edu.cn, Yixuan Qiu, Baojuan Li, Huaning Wang, Xiangyu Changabel=e5, mark]xiangyuchang@xjtu.edu.cn. Major depressive disorder (MDD) is closely related to the brain functional connectivity alterations in patients, which can be uncovered by resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) data. We consider the problem of identifying alterations of the brain functional connectivity for a single MDD patient, which is particularly difficult as the amount of data collected during an fMRI scan is too limited to provide sufficient information for individual analysis.

arxiv-2301-06426.title: Neighborhood-based Hypergraph Core Decomposition
arxiv-2301-06426.creator: Naheed Anjum Arafat, Arijit Khan, Arpit Kumar Rai, Bishwamittra Ghosh
arxiv-2301-06426.description: Abstract . We propose neighborhood-based core decomposition : a novel way of decomposing hypergraphs into hierarchical neighborhood-cohesive subhypergraphs. Alternative approaches to decomposing hypergraphs, e.g., reduction to clique or bipartite graphs, are not meaningful in certain applications, the later also results in inefficient decomposition; while existing degree-based hypergraph decomposition does not distinguish nodes with different neighborhood sizes.

arxiv-2406-08644.title: Toward Fully-End-to-End Listened Speech Decoding from EEG Signals
arxiv-2406-08644.creator: Jihwan Lee, Aditya Kommineni, Tiantian Feng, Kleanthis Avramidis, Xuan Shi, Sudarsana Reddy Kadiri, Shrikanth Narayanan
arxiv-2406-08644.description: Abstract Speech decoding from EEG signals is a challenging task, where brain activity is modeled to estimate salient characteristics of acoustic stimuli. We propose FESDE, a novel framework for F ully- E nd-to-end S peech D ecoding from E EG signals.

arxiv-2407-14709.title: ∞ \infty -Brush : Controllable Large Image Synthesis with Diffusion Models in Infinite Dimensions
arxiv-2407-14709.creator: Minh-Quan Le, Alexandros Graikos *, Srikar Yellapragada, Rajarsi Gupta, Joel Saltz, Dimitris Samaras
arxiv-2407-14709.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Minh-Quan Le, Alexandros Graikos *, Srikar Yellapragada, Rajarsi Gupta, Joel Saltz, Dimitris Samaras. Synthesizing high-resolution images from intricate, domain-specific information remains a significant challenge in generative modeling, particularly for applications in large-image domains such as digital histopathology and remote sensing. Existing methods face critical limitations: conditional diffusion models in pixel or latent space cannot exceed the resolution on which they were trained without losing fidelity, and computational demands increase significantly for larger image sizes.

arxiv-2502-20481.title: Contrary to widespread belief, the Fresnel zone plate outperforms the metalens at high NA. Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2502-20481.creator: Apratim Majumder, 1, † \dagger John A. Doughty, 1, † \dagger Tina H. Hayward, 1 Henry I. Smith, 2,3 and Rajesh Menon 1,4,*
arxiv-2502-20481.description: Abstract Rigorous simulations challenge recent claims that metalenses outperform conventional diffractive lenses, such as Fresnel Zone Plates (FZPs), in focusing efficiency at high numerical apertures (NAs). Across various lens diameters, FZPs exhibit a pronounced asymmetry in the shadow effect, leading to significantly higher focusing efficiency when optimally oriented.

arxiv-2505-22394.title: PacTure: Efficient PBR Texture Generation on Packed Views with Visual Autoregressive Models
arxiv-2505-22394.creator: Fan Fei Jiajun Tang Fei-Peng Tian Boxin Shi Ping Tan
arxiv-2505-22394.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Fan Fei Jiajun Tang Fei-Peng Tian Boxin Shi Ping Tan. We present PacTure, a novel framework for generating physically-based rendering (PBR) material textures for an untextured 3D mesh from a text description. Existing 2D generation-based texturing approaches either generate textures sequentially from different views, resulting in long inference times and globally inconsistent textures, or adopt multi-view generation with cross-view attention to enhance global consistency, which, however, limits the resolution for each view.

arxiv-2506-18280.title: Residual gauge theory for quanta of surface plasmons
arxiv-2506-18280.creator: Ken-ichi Sasaki
arxiv-2506-18280.description: Abstract We develop a gauge-theoretical framework to investigate the quanta of surface plasmons. Our formulation, based on quantum electrodynamics, highlights the importance of residual gauge symmetry. We emphasize that residual gauge symmetry, which imposes constraint equations on physical states, is fundamentally linked to Joule heating.

arxiv-2508-18088.title: How Quantization Shapes Bias in Large Language Models
arxiv-2508-18088.creator: Federico Marcuzzi, Xuefei Ning, Roy Schwartz, Iryna Gurevych
arxiv-2508-18088.description: Abstract This work presents a comprehensive evaluation of how quantization affects model bias, with particular attention to its impact on individual demographic subgroups. We focus on weight and activation quantization strategies and examine their effects across a broad range of bias types, including stereotypes, toxicity, sentiment, and fairness.

arxiv-2602-11271.title: Gas-depleted planet formation occurred in the four-planet system around the red dwarf LHS 1903
arxiv-2602-11271.creator: Thomas G. Wilson, Anna M. Simpson, Andrew Collier Cameron, Ryan Cloutier,, Vardan Adibekyan, Ancy Anna John, Yann Alibert, Manu Stalport, Jo Ann Egger,, Andrea Bonfanti, Nicolas Billot, Pascal Guterman, Pierre F. L. Maxted,, Attila E. Simon, Sérgio G. Sousa, Malcolm Fridlund, Mathias Beck, Anja Bekk
arxiv-2602-11271.description: Abstract Small exoplanet radii show two populations, referred to as super-Earths and sub-Neptunes, separated by a gap known as the radius valley. This may be produced by the removal of atmospheres due to stellar or internal heating, or lack of an initial envelope.

pmc-10510118.title: A descriptive analysis of the contents of Care Response, an international data set of patient-reported outcomes for chiropractic patients
pmc-10510118.creator: Kenneth J Young, Jane Fitzgerald, Jonathan Field, David Newell, Jim Richards
pmc-10510118.description: BackgroundDatabases have become an important tool in understanding trends and correlations in health care by collecting demographic and clinical information. Analysis of data collected from large cohorts of patients can have the potential to generate insights into factors identifying treatments and the characteristics of subgroups of patients who respond to certain types of care.

pmc-10736952.title: PUBLIC BATH USE AT A JAPANESE SENIOR APARTMENT ASSOCIATED WITH NEIGHBORHOOD RELATIONSHIPS AND SOCIAL SUPPORT
pmc-10736952.creator: Mai Takase, Isuzu Nakamoto, Hiroshi Murayama
pmc-10736952.description: The number of older adults who choose to move into senior apartments is increasing in Japan. The development of quality relationships within the senior apartment is important for the healthy aging of the residents. A “public bath” is a unique facility in Japanese senior apartment where residents can interact with each other.

pmc-11430217.title: Effects of Embryo Microbial Contamination on ART and Neonatal Outcomes
pmc-11430217.creator: Yuxia He, Yuling Mao, Yaoming Chen, Ling Tang, Haiyu Hou, Chenyun Sun, Yaqi Shang, Na-Na Tan, Lei Li
pmc-11430217.description: PurposeThis study investigated the incidence and microbial etiology of embryo contamination in assisted reproductive technology (ART), and its influence on embryo development, pregnancy and neonatal outcomes.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on embryo contamination at the Reproductive Centre of the Third Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University, between 2018 and 2021.

pmc-11561443.title: Health Care Professionals’ Experience of Using AI: Systematic Review With Narrative Synthesis
pmc-11561443.creator: Abimbola Ayorinde, Daniel Opoku Mensah, Julia Walsh, Iman Ghosh, Siti Aishah Ibrahim, Jeffry Hogg, Niels Peek, Frances Griffiths, Amaryllis Mavragani, Frada Burstein, Lucy Shinners
pmc-11561443.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThere has been a substantial increase in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) tools for clinical decision support. Historically, these were mostly knowledge-based systems, but recent advances include non–knowledge-based systems using some form of machine learning. The ability of health care professionals to trust technology and understand how it benefits patients or improves care delivery is known to be important for their adoption of that technology.

pmc-11622227.title: Regulating Local Coordination Sphere of Ir Single Atoms at the Atomic Interface for Efficient Oxygen Evolution Reaction
pmc-11622227.creator: Ashwani Kumar, Marcos Gil-Sepulcre, Jean Pascal Fandré, Olaf Rüdiger, Min Gyu Kim, Serena DeBeer, Harun Tüysüz
pmc-11622227.description: Single-atom catalysts dispersed on an oxide support are essential for overcoming the sluggishness of the oxygen evolution reaction (OER). However, the durability of most metal single-atoms is compromised under harsh OER conditions due to their low coordination (weak metal–support interactions) and excessive disruption of metal-Olattice bonds to enable lattice oxygen participation, leading to metal dissolution and hindering their practical applicability.

pmc-11625301.title: Exploring current trends in agricultural commodities forecasting methods through text mining: Developments in statistical and artificial intelligence methods
pmc-11625301.creator: Luana Gonçalves Guindani, Gilson Adamczuk Oliveirai, Matheus Henrique Dal Molin Ribeiro, Gabriel Villarrubia Gonzalez, José Donizetti de Lima
pmc-11625301.description: Agriculture stands as one of the major economic pillars worldwide, with food production contributing significantly to income growth. However, agricultural activities also entail risks associated with uncontrollable factors along the supply chain. To address these challenges, mathematical models have been developed for forecasting crucial variables in managing agribusiness activities.

pmc-12524627.title: Comparative Proteomics, Functional Characterization and Immunological Cross-Reactivity Studies on Russell’s Viper Venom from Two Distinct Geographical Regions in South India
pmc-12524627.creator: Nisha Reghu, Sudharshan Rao, Dileepkumar Raveendran, Bipin Gopalakrishnan Nair, Muralidharan Vanuopadath
pmc-12524627.description: Snakebite envenoming is a neglected tropical disease contributing to a significant number of morbidities and mortalities globally. Reports indicate that venom variation influences antivenom efficacy, which might affect treatment outcomes. The venom composition of Daboia russelii (Russell’s viper), one of the big four snakes in India, has been extensively studied from different geographical regions of India.

pmc-12932332.title: Robotic mini- or less open sublay for anterior abdominal wall hernia repair using the da Vinci single port robotic platform (SP MILOS): a preclinical feasibility study
pmc-12932332.creator: Alexander D Schroeder, Jorge L Florin, Christopher J Johnson, David C Chen, Conrad Ballecer, Michael Schroeder, Clark Gerhart, Wolfgang Reinpold
pmc-12932332.description: PurposeEndoscopic Mini or Less Open Sublay (eMILOS) is a transhernial endoscopically assisted approach for anterior abdominal wall hernia repair that has demonstrated excellent long-term outcomes. Performed through a small skin incision directly over the hernia, the eMILOS technique minimizes additional access trauma, but remains technically demanding with conventional instruments.

pmc-13223824.creator: Mairi H Northcott, Ashwin Subramaniam, Daryl Jones, Andrew Casamento, Yasmine Ali Abdelhamid, Deepak Bhonaghiri, Krishnaswamy Sundararajan
pmc-13223824.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13233511.title: Symptoms and Knowledge of Dental Erosion Among Hong Kong Adults
pmc-13233511.creator: Ivy Guofang Sun, Xinyu Liu, Iris Xiaoxue Yin, Jane Jing Zhang, Xuliang Deng, Chun Hung Chu
pmc-13233511.description: ObjectiveThis study investigates self-reported symptoms and knowledge of dental erosion among adults in Hong Kong.MethodsA 2-week online self-administered closed-ended questionnaire was conducted in 2025, with pre-verified panel members aged 25 to 45 years invited via the Hong Kong Public Opinion Research Institute’s online platform.

pmc-13407231.title: Herbal Bioactives Targeting Rho GTPases: A Multi-Targeted Strategy for Mitigating Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s Diseases
pmc-13407231.creator: Tzong-Shi Wang, I-Shiang Tzeng, Yi-Chyan Chen, Mao-Liang Chen
pmc-13407231.description: Neuroinflammation plays an essential role in the pathogenesis of several associated brain diseases, including neurodegenerative disorders (Alzheimer’s disease (AD), Parkinson’s disease (PD), multiple sclerosis (MS)), and traumatic brain injury (TBI). In these diseases, persistent microglial and astrocyte aggregates, elevated proinflammatory cytokines, and oxidative stress drive neuronal injury and cognitive disability.

pmc-13494730.title: Acute pain in cats: knowledge, attitudes and practices among Argentine veterinarians – a survey-based study
pmc-13494730.creator: Eduardo Alcides Alegre, Patricia Koscinczuk, Renata Santiago Alberto Carlos, Mário Sérgio Lima de Lavor
pmc-13494730.description: ObjectivesThe aim of the present study was to investigate Argentine veterinarians’ knowledge, attitudes and management of acute pain in cats.MethodsA voluntary, anonymous, prospective, cross-sectional online survey was conducted among Argentine veterinarians between January and September 2024. The questionnaire explored demographics, clinical practice and acute pain management in cats.

uslaw-usc-t19-s2502.description: United States Code, Title 19 (Customs Duties); Chapter 13 (Trade Agreements Act Of 1979). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The purposes of this Act are— (1) to approve and implement the trade agreements negotiated under the Trade Act of 1974 [19 U.S.C. 2101 et seq.]; (2) to foster the growth and maintenance of an open world trading system; (3) to expand opportunities.

uslaw-usc-t29-s49i.title: 29 U.S.C. § 49i — Recordkeeping and accountability
uslaw-usc-t29-s49i.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t29-s49i.description: United States Code, Title 29 (Labor); Chapter 4B (Federal Employment Service). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Records Each State shall keep records that are sufficient to permit the preparation of reports required by this chapter and to permit the tracing of funds to a level of expenditure adequate to insure that the funds have not been spent unlawfully. (b) Investigations (1).
